status: Local trace enrichment is useful for body-field accuracy but NOT promoted to a time-domain solver
interpretation: The near/far split acts on one surface trace and lifts both parts harmonically. No three-dimensional potential is multiplied by a window.
Current coarse-global nodal sampling leaves far trace error; a compact local correction cannot change the plane Dirichlet trace outside its support.
Finer local P1 improves body fields and trace approximation but does not establish suitable pointwise surface evolution. P1 nodal/edge DNO can be singular.
Pointwise water accuracy is diagnostic, not a new user requirement. Acceptance remains0.1degree/1cm THROUGHOUT60s and <=20wall seconds/simsecond with nonlinear6DOF.

internal_source_control.role: Demanding analytic fixture with source locations frozen before body discretization; reflected sources give exact lower-halfspace lift and same-J lifting oracle.
internal_source_control.decision: Fails physical-field qualification: local correction approaches the exact-lift oracle, but that coarse-body oracle has a large error against the independent internal-pole field. This is not a production mesh requirement.

representative_snapshot.scope: Unit-velocity heave/roll external snapshots represented by four REAL phase columns; actual evaluated Capytaine velocity, not kappaPhi, is the field reference. Its finite-panel uncertainty remains.
representative_snapshot.decision: Do not promote. Better body-field accuracy alone is insufficient evidence for the coupled water evolution. Boundary-concentrated error and coarse-far representation error remain distinct.

timing.scope: Static CPU verification includes independent references, fields, body solves and local application; not a simulation throughput measurement or controlled implementation speed comparison.

next_decisive_test: Weak compact-P1 DtN: verify 2*grad^T*V*grad and exploit translation invariance on a uniform structured patch for zero-padded FFT convolution. Compare against an independent small assembled operator before any moving integration. Preserve global/local cross coupling and physical hull-hole ownership.
limits: No nonlinear evolving sea or time-domain rigid-body trajectory in this experiment.
Full known auxiliary trace is supplied; hidden-state and moving-waterline transfer are not solved.
No baseline speed or60s accuracy claim.
No further uniform local refinement before separating trace evaluation and coarse-far errors.
weak_operator_invariants: Weak stiffness is K=2*B^T*V*B; evolve with the consistent mass M, not K alone.
Uniform planar translated hats admit a finite Toeplitz kernel and zero-padded FFT application; preserve aperiodic tails.
Zero-perimeter compact patch does not have zero row sums: no diagonal/gauge repair.

The full-plane weak identity does not justify simply deleting hidden triangles or evolving fictitious water. Begin with test hats whose entire support is physical exterior; contact restriction and cross coupling remain explicit work.
